stage: 6 full model (prefill-only classifier); stage-1 fields below kept as recorded
hardware: 1x Blackhole p150a, 8 DRAM banks, 31.83 GiB DRAM (measured: ttnn.get_memory_view)
limiting_reason_detail: Person-approved adapted contract (tt-ops runs/pplx-decider-v1-27b/notes.md): the classifier app never feeds more than 8192 tokens. This is NOT a device-DRAM limit. The plugin checker (check_context_contract.py) only accepts DRAM-limited reductions, so it reports this contract as a reduction; see notes.
app_contract_evidence: Every module and both decoder-layer kinds (layers 0, 61 linear_attention; 3, 63 full_attention) pass HF PCC >= 0.995 at S=8192 with real weights; min PCC over all cases 0.999897 (gated_deltanet L61 S8192). Log: artifacts/pplx_decider/logs/pytest_pcc_1b.log (124 passed, exit 0).

public_prefill_contract.rule: The prompt is padded on the right to the next bucket; the classifier reads the hidden state of the last REAL token (index = real_length - 1).
public_prefill_contract.why_right_padding_is_exact: Both mixers are causal (causal SDPA; Gated DeltaNet conv and recurrence only look backwards), so right-pad tokens cannot change the hidden state of any real token (inferred from the layer math; end-to-end check of the last-real-token readout is a stage-6 item).
public_prefill_contract.decision: Person decision 2026-10-09 (orchestrator amendment). It replaces the functional-decoder plugin's arbitrary-logical-length requirement. The layer code itself still accepts any length 1..max_seq_len (chunks of 2048 plus a tail); only the buckets are tested and supported.
public_prefill_contract.batch_gt_1_left_padding: not implemented (HF zeroes left-pad rows inside Gated DeltaNet when batch > 1; the app's inference.py runs batch 1)

decode: N/A: prefill-only classifier (Qwen3_5Model(..., use_cache=False).last_hidden_state[:, -1] -> readout); no KV cache across requests, no decode step.

prefill_chunking.state_carried_on_device: attention K/V in a request-local paged cache (pages of 32, identity page table, sized for max_seq_len); DeltaNet fp32 recurrent state [1,48,128,128] and the last 3 conv inputs
prefill_chunking.request_isolation_evidence: tests/pcc/test_prefill_contract.py runs 8192 -> 128 -> 2048 -> 4096 on one loaded instance per kind; all PCC >= 0.99999; the repeated last request is bit-identical

beyond_app_probe.note: Evidence only. 16384 is not part of the supported contract; it shows the chunked per-layer path is not capped at 8192 by code or by per-layer DRAM.

dram_evidence.source: ttnn.get_memory_view(device, DRAM) in tests/probe/test_context_probe.py; allocated = num_banks x total_bytes_allocated_per_bank
dram_evidence.setup_includes: BFP8 weights, BF16 norms, fp32 DeltaNet zero state and scan constants, the BF16 K/V cache sized for max_seq_len (full_attention), RoPE tables (full_attention) and the BF16 [1,S,5120] input
dram_evidence.full_model_projection_inferred: 64 layers at S=8192 with this per-layer policy: 48 x 0.386 + 16 x 0.402 GiB (setup minus the 80 MiB input) = 24.9 GiB, plus the 2.37 GiB BF16 embedding table = 27.2 GiB of 31.83 GiB, leaving about 4.6 GiB for activations. Transient peak inside a pass was not measured. At 262144 tokens the BF16 K/V caches alone would be 16 x 1 GiB, which does not fit with BFP8 weights. A BFP8 K/V cache with BFP4 MLP weights might fit; this is not tested.

full_model_dram_measured.source: ttnn.get_memory_view(device, DRAM) in tt/model.py dram_view(); stage-6 scratch probes, results in artifacts/pplx_decider/stage6/{load_times.json,dram_peak_S8192.json}
full_model_dram_measured.policy: act_bf16__w_bfp8_all__hifi2 (BF16 activations, BFP8 projection weights, BF16 embedding / norms, BF16 K/V cache, fp32 DeltaNet state)
full_model_dram_measured.per_layer_note: per-layer delta at load: weights plus the layer's persistent state (fp32 DeltaNet zero state and scan constants; BF16 paged K/V cache 2 x 16 MiB sized for 8192 tokens, page table, RoPE trans mat)
